messages:
Rhea: quick request  can we harvest pilot feedback into one compact list for product tomorrow AM? focus: onboarding blockers, observable renewal flags, and immediate enablement needs
Diego: will do. i'll pull three pilot notes and paste raw snippets here. prefer a CSV with columns: customer, ask, severity(low/med/high), renewal_risk(yes/no/unclear), quote, contact, triage(doc/eng/ops), eta_estimate
Caleb: i'll add an enablement recommendation column (docs/runbook/workshop) and a short `time-to-visible-fix` (days/weeks/sprints).
Nia: heads-up: include call timestamps + recording links so eng can repro quickly. keep rows one-line so product can scan.
Diego: raw snippets from calls ->
- Orion: multi-tenant token reconciliation fails intermittently during onboarding; "tokens mismatched between UI and API" -> high severity, renewal flagged in call, demo couldn't proceed
- Pylon: accounting needs a per-tenant billing export (CSV) and clearer billing-period labeling in UI -> med severity, unclear renewal risk, finance asked for export now
- Vera: webhook delivery latency causes duplicate events in customer pipeline; workaround is to dedupe client-side -> high severity, renewal concern expressed
Caleb: note for Pylon: docs-first plus a short billing-export script sample should help quickly. i'll draft a one-pager.
Rhea: Diego, please attach any API error snippets or stack traces for Orion and Vera. product wants LOE estimates tomorrow.
Diego: attaching quick log lines and endpoints in CSV: Orion endpoint `/v1/orgs/reconcile`, sample error "WARN token-mismatch uid=...", Vera endpoint `/v1/webhooks/dispatch` with 500/504 spikes. CSV uploaded: <drive/internal/1799012345-pilot-harvest.csv> 
Nia: triage plan: mark Orion as "needs immediate triage" (eng), Vera as "eng + ops" for webhook retries/backoff, Pylon as "docs + small UI tweak". adding impact scores: Orion=5, Vera=4, Pylon=3.
prod-bot: Reminder: product sync 10am PT tomorrow  add this CSV to pre-read. :spiral_calendar:
Caleb: prepping enablement artifacts: Pylon billing sample + short runbook for finance. estimate 2 days.
Diego: filed ENG-12521 for Orion with attached logs and repro steps; set priority = P0.
Rhea: action items recap: Diego cleans CSV with impact scores and contact emails by EOD, Caleb drafts Pylon playbook, Nia files the Vera incident details and possible mitigations, i'll deliver the digest to @product for triage.
Nia: added call_ts and recordings to the CSV. flagged which customers mentioned renewals explicitly.
Diego: CSV final: <drive/internal/1799012345-pilot-harvest.csv>  3 rows, quotes, logs, contact emails.
Rhea: perfect  i'll ping product. if product asks for more detail, please paste trace snippets and sample payloads inline to speed estimation.
prod-bot: Backlog updated with 3 new items from this thread.
Rhea: closing loop for now. if anyone else sees pilot notes, drop them here with call_ts and i'll append to the CSV. :white_check_mark:
